package_entry_rule: Each packages entry maps a stable package ID to its package metadata path.
rules: Binary/native resources use architecture-specific artifacts; pure-source or architecture-independent packages may use any/source.
A package ID is the stable machine-readable identifier used by registry clients.
Package names are human-facing and may differ from package IDs.
Clients should resolve package metadata through registry/index.json instead of hardcoding artifact URLs.
A package version belongs to one stable package ID; different package IDs have independent version histories.
Aliases must resolve to exactly one package ID and must not collide with package IDs or other aliases.
Contributor manifests are intake metadata; published registry metadata is generated or maintained by 22.
The published author field preserves the original author name; an optional author_username can preserve the submitting account identity.
Generated publication artifacts must preserve applicable third-party license and attribution files.
